news.title: BE/B.Tech Results Declared
news.content: VTU declared BE/B.Tech Dec 2025/Jan 2026 results on March 3, 2026. BBA/BCA results were declared on March 16. Check them at results.vtu.ac.in.

news.title: Draft Timetable June/July 2026
news.content: Draft timetables for June/July 2026 Semester End Exams are currently out for review. Final timetables expect by mid-April.

news.title: 2025 Scheme AI Integration
news.content: The 2025 scheme mandates AI subjects for all 1st-year students. Braintube is already preparing notes for these new subjects.
